Subject: Launch plan & MAP: Novus Health - confirm roles & pilot timeline

Hi Priya —

Great speaking with you last week. As discussed, I put together a quick mutual action plan (MAP) draft to align on goals, owners, and a realistic timeline toward a constrained pilot. The attached spreadsheet has the milestones we talked about (evaluation criteria, integration checkpoints, security docs, and decision dates).

Top asks to move this forward:
- Can you confirm the internal champion and primary technical contact for the pilot?
- Are the evaluation criteria in tab "Success Metrics" aligned with your stakeholder expectations (security, latency, and cost targets)?
- Is the 8-week pilot window (target kickoff July 12) feasible from your side?

We'll hold a 30-minute MAP kickoff to assign owners and lock dates once you confirm — suggested slot next week. Lauren (cc'd) will lead the trial operations from Redwood; Jonas will support architecture and the integration checklist.

Attached: Novus_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx, Novus_Eval_Criteria.docx

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez

sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0167

Sergio —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft. I’m the champion for the initiative and I’ll coordinate exec-level sign-off. I’ve looped Tom, our lead on integrations and security, on this thread.

Initial answers:
- Champion: Priya Sharma (me) — I’ll be the decision owner.
- Technical lead: Tom Brooks — owns EHR integration and infra readiness.
- The evaluation criteria look reasonable; I want to add a short checklist around PHI handling and audit log retention (Tom will add specifics).
- July 12 kickoff is optimistic but possible if we finalize the security questionnaire and a scoped test dataset by July 5.

I’m available for a 30-min kickoff on Tuesday, June 29 at 10:00am ET or Thursday, July 1 at 2:00pm ET. Which works for you?

—Priya
